result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data export within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. It preserves the original termination mechanics. However, the final legal-retention carveout changes the Licensee’s existing return obligations and is not needed to implement the transition playbook; it is also somewhat mismatched because the original clause requires shipment, not deletion. Otherwise, the drafting is professional, though “thereafter” leaves the deletion deadline open-ended.
